title: Supersedable Trait Parameters
description: Configuration contract for the Supersedable trait: which supersession states a store can write, and which direction it records the lineage pointer in.

states.description: The supersession states the source of truth can actually write.

items.description: Supersession state identifier such as active, superseded, archived or stale.

initialState.description: The state a newly recorded entry holds before anything replaces it. Must be a member of states.

recordedDirection.description: Which pointer the source of truth writes: forward stores superseded_by on the replaced record, backward stores supersedes on the replacing record, both stores each.

supersededLabel.description: Visible wording for a record that has been replaced, so the state never rests on colour alone.
